Frontend: All features working correctly including Comments button on search results, Content Filtering UI in Settings, Map Category Filtering with color-coded dots, Theme Gallery and Preview modals, and Easter Eggs with Protocol Script Recommendations and Protocol Pricing jokes.
critical_code_review_comments: Login flow working correctly with admin credentials (jjspilot24@gmail.com / InfoPilot2024!)
Comments button on search results opens slide-in panel with 'Comments (0)' header and 'No comments yet' message
Content Filtering UI in Settings has 3 options: Strict (Default), Moderate, Off (Adult Content Enabled)
Map View Category Filter shows color-coded checkboxes with category names and result counts
Category Filtered Results panel appears at bottom when categories selected, showing grid of matching results
Theme Gallery modal has Browse/My Presets/Create New tabs with preset cards showing name, author, likes, accent color
Theme Preview modal shows split-screen Dark/Light mode comparison with 6 accent color options each

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 64 verified all features: 1) Login flow works with admin credentials. 2) Comments button on search results opens SearchResultComments panel (slide-in from right). 3) Settings page has Content Filtering section with Strict/Moderate/Off radio buttons. 4) Map View has Filter by Category section with color-coded checkboxes showing category names and counts. 5) When categories selected, Category Results panel appears at bottom with filtered results grid. 6) Theme Gallery button opens modal with Browse/My Presets/Create tabs. 7) Theme Preview button opens split-screen Dark/Light comparison with 6 accent colors. 8) Easter Eggs contain Protocol Script Recommendations, Protocol Pricing tips, and extremely funny jokes about Letters to Evelyn by John Selman. 9) Clean Category button in Edit Category Modal has 3 modes for cleaning results.

Login_Flow.details: Admin login with jjspilot24@gmail.com / InfoPilot2024! works correctly

Comments_Button.details: Comments button with data-testid='open-comments-{id}' on search results. Opens SearchResultComments panel with header 'Comments (0)' and input for new comments.

Content_Filtering_UI.details: Settings page has Content Filtering section with data-testid='content-filter-section'. Three options: Strict (Default), Moderate, Off (Adult Content Enabled). Each has proper styling and description.

Map_Category_Filter.details: Map View has Filter by Category section with data-testid='category-filter-section'. Shows color-coded checkboxes with category names and result counts. Collapse/Expand button works.

Map_Color_Coded_Dots.details: Categories have unique colors from CATEGORY_COLORS array. Dots appear next to category names and on map markers when filtered.

Map_Filtered_Results_Panel.details: When categories selected, Category Results panel with data-testid='category-filtered-results' appears at bottom. Shows grid of filtered results with category badges, article types, locations, and hashtags.

Theme_Gallery_Button.details: Button with data-testid='open-theme-gallery' in sidebar. Opens Theme Gallery modal with Browse/My Presets/Create New tabs.

Theme_Preview_Button.details: Button with data-testid='open-theme-preview' in sidebar. Opens Visual Theme Preview modal with split-screen Dark/Light comparison.

Easter_Egg_Content.details: FloatingEasterEggs.js contains Protocol Script Recommendations (type: 'protocol'), Protocol Pricing suggestions (type: 'pricing'), and extremely funny jokes about Letters to Evelyn by John Selman.

Clean_Category_Button.details: Edit Category Modal has Clean Category button with data-testid='clean-category-btn'. Backend API /api/categories/{id}/clean supports 3 modes: remove, delete, delete_all.
